title: Actions Workflow Map: Repository-Wide GitHub Actions Visualization and Analysis
description: Actions Workflow Map is an open-source, local-first developer tool that converts GitHub Actions workflow configurations into visual and machine-readable operational maps. Version 0.2.0 supports both individual workflow analysis and repository-wide discovery. It maps triggers, jobs, needs dependencies, matrices, local reusable workflows, permissions, concurrency groups, environments, external action references, and artifact producer-consumer relationships. The tool generates Mermaid diagrams, self-contained HTML reports, JSON reports, console summaries, and deterministic evidence-linked findings.
